jobs.occupation: Relationship Support Associate - 6 months contract - M/F/X
jobs.description:
The Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) role involves supporting corporate banking processes with precision and efficiency. This position requires a strong command of English and attention to detail to ensure effective operations.

Client Details

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.
• Provide support for audits and other compliance activities.Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking)

A successful Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) should have:

• A strong command of English, both written and spoken.
• Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in finance or similar.
• Experience or knowledge in the financial services industry.
• Proficiency in using banking systems and tools.
• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.
• Applicants must already be based in Belgium and possess valid authorization to work in Belgium at the time of application.

The Finance Officer will handle key accounting and finance tasks, ensuring accurate financial records and compliance with regulations. 

Client Details

The company is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.

• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

• A proactive mindset.

As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

Client Details

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for growing the company's presence in Belgium by identifying opportunities, managing client portfolios, and driving commercial success.

Client Details

Join an innovative and fast-growing technology company that helps organizations optimize their digital document and information management processes. With a strong reputation in its sector and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its presence across the Belgian market.

Description

• Develop and expand the Belgian market through active business development.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Identify client needs and propose tailored solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract negotiation.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients

• You know how staffing and consulting work.

Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.

• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Manually picking orders
• Packing and labelling products
• Processing shipping documents
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.

• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
• You speak English fluently
